title: Discharge measurements of Eaton Creek near Pasadena., Calif., during the year ending September 30, 1922
notes: Two side-by-side blocks (Date, Made by, Gage height, Discharge); left block has 11 rows, right block 10, so the last row of the right block is empty. Second header row holds the units. Date gives the month only when it changes. "do" printed between dashed leaders without a period. Heavy, over-inked type: several 5/6/8/9/0 digits are filled in.
